title: U.S. Conference of Mayors Kick Off Fall Leadership Meeting in San Diego
description: San Diego, Calif. – The U.S. Conference of Mayors (USCM) hold a press conference to open its 2026 Fall Leadership Meeting in San Diego, California, where a bipartisan group of more than 50 mayors from across the country will convene to discuss solutions to the most urgent challenges facing cities, including housing affordability, public safety, and the rising cost of living.
